version: v3.7 (2026-10-02 PT): location bosses ~15 correct answers, realm bosses ~20, even with a full MP bar spent on spells (v3.6: 20 for both); v3.6: no MP regen on correct answers, boss ATK x0.8; no MP hints. v3.5 rules kept: free cast (no question, no fizzle), no cast caps, Magic Ward removed, Freeze 1 turn and not on bosses, 2-3 s skippable cast animation

rules.price_unit: G(t) = gold per normal enemy at the selling town = 3 x L_rec(t)
rules.damage: max(1, round(power x (Tired ? 1.5 : 1) - DEF_e)); fixed power (no ATK/gear/level scaling), full enemy DEF, no streak or spoken bonus
rules.design_rule: power = round(F x HP_normal(t) + DEF(t)); mp = round(K x MP_pool(t)), MP_pool = 10 + 2 x L_rec(t); v3.5 K = 1.25 x v3.4 K (0.41-0.60)
rules.cast: free action: uses the hero turn, asks no question, cannot fizzle; MP is always spent; no streak change on that turn
rules.mp_regen: none (v3.6): MP comes back only at the inn, on waking after a defeat, or from map-only Mana Tea / Big Mana Tea
rules.boss_target: about 15 correct answers per location boss and about 20 per realm boss, even with a full MP bar spent on spells (v3.7; v3.6 was 20 for both)
rules.cast_rule_text: no per-battle cap and no unlock: cast any turn while MP >= cost (back-to-back allowed); MP is the only limit (v3.5)
rules.mp_strategy: saving MP for elites and bosses is the kid's call; no hints anywhere (v3.6)
rules.boss_status: bosses resist statuses (half chance); Super Blizzard Freeze does not affect bosses
rules.freeze: Super Blizzard: every non-boss target skips its next attack (lasts 1 turn)
rules.cast_animation: about 2-3 s; a tap skips it
rules.ownership: permanent; castable in any battle when MP >= cost and the cast rule allows
rules.magic_ward: removed (decided v3.5; was x0.5 spell damage in boss battles in v3.3)
rules.spell_power: fixed per spell; no magic stat or wand scaling (decided v3.5)
rules.mp_potions_note: map only (never in battle), so a potion never replaces a question turn
rules.blacksmith_first: the magic shop reminds the kid when a purchase would leave less gold than the next town's weapon + armor + shield
rules.same_turn: a spell replaces the attack; it never combines with Frost/Sweep on the same turn; companion team attack is unchanged

spells.visual: A plum-sized orange fireball with a curly tail of sparks, thrown from the wand tip. On hit: a warm puff of orange light and a few floating embers. No scorch marks, nothing burns.

spells.status: Soaked: the target's next attack does half damage
spells.visual: A stream of shiny rainbow soap bubbles that wraps the enemy in a big wobbly bubble for a moment; when it pops the enemy is dripping and grumpy, with a little water cloud over its head.
Fluffy snowballs pop out of the air and pelt every enemy of the chosen kind; soft white bursts and a sprinkle of snowflakes. Enemies shiver comically.

spells.status: Dazed: 25% chance the target skips its next attack (bosses 12.5%)
spells.visual: A small zig-zag bolt from a palm-sized storm cloud; yellow flash, the target's fur/hair stands up and little stars circle its head when dazed.
A melon-sized fireball with a bright yellow core and a spiral trail; a round orange flash and a ring of sparks on impact.
A green-white spinning gust with leaves in it that lifts every enemy of the chosen kind, spins them like tops and drops them dizzy.
Big sparkling snowflakes swirl across the whole screen and tap each enemy (max 3) with a soft chime; frost glitter on their shoulders.

Golden sunbeams break through grey clouds onto every enemy of the chosen kind; zombies/skeletons sneeze and look a bit more cheerful (ties to the "cured by kind words" theme).
A big round fireball with a smiling glow that grows above the hero before it is thrown; big orange burst with confetti-like sparks.
